scenes.hook: An A I chip is not a tiny person inside your laptop. It is hardware designed for particular calculations.
scenes.idea: A C P U handles general computing. A G P U processes many operations in parallel.
scenes.demo: An N P U specializes in neural network workloads, helping supported A I tasks run efficiently on a device.
scenes.compare: These processors work together. An app may use one or several depending on the operation.
scenes.takeaway: A bigger marketing number alone does not tell you the whole experience. Software support and memory matter too.
scenes.close: Which chip does your app use? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
